CustomField.description: JSON object mapping each source column header to a canonical field: repCode, advisorName, firmName, fundName, tradeDate, amount, transactionType, or IGNORE. Every column in the file must appear, so nothing is silently dropped.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How each column in the file maps to a trade field. Every column must be mapped or marked IGNORE.
CustomField.label: Column Map
